notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

[h3][b]Multiple New Game Modes[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Hilo:[/b] Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
[*] [b]Speed:[/b] In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
[*] [b]Squares:[/b] Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
[*] [b]Bounce:[/b] In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer![/list]
[b]But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.[/b]



[i]Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.[/i]

notes.title: Add The Jackbox Naughty Pack to your Wishlist on Steam Today!
notes.content:
What’s The Jackbox Naughty Pack? I’m so pleased you asked. Take a seat on my perfectly maintained 70s chic conversation pit couch, grab at least two friends, and get ready for an absolutely raucous game night. 

The Jackbox Naughty Pack is rated M for Mature. Watch the trailer to learn more here:

 [previewyoutube=FTAYOPKYDuU;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to play three tantalizingly silly party games, each supporting 3-8 players:
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Fakin’ It All Night Long[/b][/h3] (Social Deduction): Fakin’ It returns and this time we’re putting it all out there. Everyone gets a secret task except the Faker, who tries to blend in. Find out which of your friends is the best liar… and SO much more! Featuring new categories and a brand new “remote play” mode. 
[*] [h3][b]Dirty Drawful[/b][/h3] (Drawing, Guessing): It’s Drawful, but  dirty… It’s Dirty Drawful. We’ve taken the Drawful that you love and added spicy prompts to ensure your drawings are both terrible and titillating. We also may have added an “undo” button for this one, but don’t tell anyone. 
[*] [h3][b]Let Me Finish[/b][/h3] (Debate): Let Me Finish is Jackbox’s new presentation game that examines life’s serious questions like, “Where is the mailbox’s butt?” or “How does this avocado get aroused?” Everyone gets a chance to speak their mind but will others pick up what you’re putting down?
[/list]
The Jackbox Naughty Pack will launch this Thursday, [b]September 12, 2024[/b] and retail for [b]$21.69[/b] ([i]nice[/i]). This product will be available on all major platforms upon release.

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652000/The_Jackbox_Naughty_Pack/][i][b]Add it to your wishlist on Steam now! [/b][/i][/url][/h2]

notes.title: The Jackbox Decade Bundle Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h3]Wow! Ten years of Party Packs! So much has happened during this past decade, and none of it has been vaguely apocalyptic, right? . . . [i][b]RIGHT??[/b][/i][/h3]

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is great for anyone looking to guarantee they’ll never have to deal with figuring out what to do with friends again, or as a gift to ensure your loved one is set for every party for the rest of their lives.

[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/bundles/the-jackbox-decade-bundle][img]https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/19_PP10_TKO2-0030_Upscaled_1024x1024@2x.png?v=1712185770[/img][/url]

[h3]What is the Jackbox Decade Bundle?[/h3]

We are celebrating ten years of party games by releasing all of our Party Pack titles into one big bundle! That’s right! 50 games from Party Packs 1-10 for one low price of $199.99!

Play fan favorites like Quiplash, Trivia Murder Party, and Tee K.O. with your grandma! Or some hidden gems like Job Job, Role Models, or Monster Seeking Monster with that one coworker who smells like corn chips! The possibilities are truly endless!

[url=https://shop.jackboxgames.com/collections/staging-bundles/products/the-jackbox-decade-bundle][img]https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/laptop_quiplash_1024x1024@2x.jpg?v=1712185770[/img][/url]

[h3]Where can I buy the Jackbox Decade Bundle?[/h3]

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is available on Sony consoles, Microsoft consoles, Nintendo Switch, and Steam. Only one player needs to own the bundle for everyone else to join together in the room or over video conferencing apps. And the best part is, with Jackbox Games, your phone is the controller, so there’s no special equipment required! Already own all our games? You’re amazing. The Jackbox Decade Bundle makes a great [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/a-guide-to-buying-jackbox-games-as-a-gift][b]gift[/b][/url] as well. 

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38173/The_Jackbox_Decade_Bundle/][b]Buy now![/b][/url][/h1]

[b]Note for international:[/b]
The Jackbox Party Bundle includes all Party Packs. Only The Jackbox Party Pack 9 and The Jackbox Party Pack 10 are available fully translated to French, Italian, German, Spanish and/or Portuguese.

notes.title: All Five Games Coming to The Jackbox Party Pack 10 - Wishlist Today!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216830/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_10/]Wishlist The Jackbox Party Pack 10 today![/url][/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216830/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_10/][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33030169/2a7724727936241d9b55be3bf07d6784393a95a7.png[/img][/url]

--- 

We’ve almost made another trip around the sun since The Jackbox Party Pack 9 was released and it’s time to dust off your space boots and get ready for the launch of The Jackbox Party Pack 10! A brand new pack of 5 party games is set to arrive this fall and blast your parties into another hilarious dimension.

The Jackbox Party Pack 10 will be available at launch in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian Spanish, and Latin American Spanish. These games are perfect for your family holidays, game nights with friends, work happy hour, or to play alongside your favorite streamer.

[h2]Here are the 5 games in The Jackbox Party Pack 10:[/h2]

[i][h1]Tee K.O 2[/h1][/i]

(Drawing, Writing): In Tee K.O. 2, return to T-Shirt Island, where the most hardened warriors in the world compete in a deadly fighting tournament. The drawing finger – not the fist – decides the victory! Tee K.O. 2 supports 3-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/get-a-first-look-at-an-early-version-of-tee-k-o-2-in-the-jackbox-party-pack-10/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer and first look video with RubberRoss below:
[previewyoutube=gF_MLy6b5gg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=egOQAaUylUc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]FixyText[/i][/h1]

(Writing, Teamwork): FixyText is the Wild West of text-editing. In this chaotic game, everyone’s in a group chat, typing all at once to make the most memorable statement. And there’s no delete key. Take that auto-correct! FixyText supports 3-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/fixytext-is-the-second-game-coming-this-fall-in-the-jackbox-party-pack-10/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer and first look video with Outside Xbox below.
[previewyoutube=71Q0fzMiwCg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=B0hyCEdSKfo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]Hypnotorious[/i][/h1]

(Hidden Identity, Roleplaying): Hypnotorious is a game with secret roles, tentative alliances and of course, silly answers to ridiculous questions. Who is on your side? Hypnotorious supports 4-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/hypnotorious-is-coming-to-the-jackbox-party-pack-10-this-fall/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=IUgQezHhHk8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=6rA-y7XLFys;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]Timejinx[/i][/h1]

(Trivia): In Timejinx, you’re a time traveler from the future competing in a high-stakes trivia night. Save your current timeline by answering questions about the past. Timejinx supports 1-8 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/timejinx-is-coming-to-the-jackbox-party-pack-10-this-fall-2/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=8uDGDc3_a2A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][i]Dodo Re Mi[/i][/h1]

(Music, Teamwork): In Dodo Re Mi, your phone is your instrument. You and your flock must make music together to escape the hungry jungle plant. Dodo Re Mi supports 1-9 players. Read [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/dodo-re-mi-party-pack-ten/]this[/url] to learn more or watch the trailer below.
[previewyoutube=u-hHxjJEUM0;full][/previewyoutube]

The Jackbox Party Pack 10 is coming to major platforms later this fall. Follow us on social media for updates on more early looks at gameplay and for an official release date announcement. You can find us on [url=http://twitter.com/jackboxgames]Twitter[/url], [url=http://instagram.com/playjackboxgames]Instagram[/url], [url=http://facebook.com/jackboxgames]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playjackboxgames]TikTok[/url]!
